Name: Pokemon Day Care - Bobbers
Author: Parme69
Description:
[size=5][b]Pokemon Day Care - Bobbers[/b][/size]

Cast your line and a Poke Ball floats on the water.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]The whole bobber sheet is redrawn with Poke Balls[/*]
[*]Works with the bobber styles from the bobber machine[/*]
[*]No settings, just install and fish[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip into your Mods folder. Safe to add or remove at any time, it only changes images.
[b]Updating from an older version:[/b] the mod ID changed to Parme.PokemonDayCareBobbers. Delete the old folder before installing this one.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
Any other mod that edits the bobber sheet (TileSheets/bobbers) will conflict; the last one loaded wins.

[b]Pokemon Day Care series[/b]
This mod is part of the Pokemon Day Care series but does not need the main mod.

Downloads.Description:
Delete the old folder before installing; your settings go back to default.
Use it with or without Pokemon Day Care expansion

Manifest.Description: Replaces the fishing bobbers with Poke Balls.
